pages.title: Arthur Mourgue: research engineer in AI for robotics
pages.description: Research engineer in AI for robotics. I design, train and deploy AI models directly on robotic systems. Building LaMain, an open-source robot hand with touch. Looking for an end-of-studies internship from March 2027.

pages.title: LaMain · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: LaMain: an open-source three-finger robot hand with touch for the SO-101 arm. 5 DOF, printable, under 200 g (target).
pages.og_description: An open-source three-finger robot hand with touch for the SO-101 arm.

pages.title: LePotager · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: LePotager: a robot arm that sorts fruit by pressing it, using imitation learning on vision and touch. Built in 48 h at the HF LeRobot hackathon.
pages.og_description: A robot arm that sorts fruit by touch, built in 48 h at the HF LeRobot hackathon.

pages.title: Cart docking · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: Cart docking at Capra Robotics: LiDAR cart pose estimation for autonomous mobile robots, sub-centimetre and under 45 ms on CPU.
pages.og_description: LiDAR cart pose estimation for autonomous mobile robots, under 45 ms on CPU.

pages.title: DagoBERT · Arthur Mourgue
pages.description: DagoBERT: a local language model that turns plain English into embedded C++ for ARM flight-test hardware, presented at ETTC 2025.
pages.og_description: A local language model that turns plain English into embedded C++ for ARM hardware.
